claim: Formby (National Trust) car parks at Lifeboat Road and Victoria Road open 09:00-17:00, parking £9 (free for NT members and blue badge); beach is open all day; dogs welcome.
quote: Beaches: Open all day | Lifeboat Road car park: 09:00 - 17:00 | Victoria Road car park: 09:00 - 17:00 ... Car parking costs £9.00 ... Free parking for National Trust members ... Dogs are welcome at Formby

claim: Crosby Beach's 'Another Place' is best visited with the tide times in mind; the nearest car parks are at Hall Road (L23 8SY), Mariners Road and Cambridge Road, and Merseyrail runs trains every ~15 minutes to Hall Road/Blundellsands/Waterloo.
quote: Before visiting the beach, please familiarise yourself with the tide times ... Hall Road, Blundellsands (L23 8SY) - closest to Another Place ... Trains run approximately every 15 minutes

claim: Crosby Coastal Park surrounds the Gormley sculptures with a marine lake, formal gardens, playground and the start of the 22-mile Sefton Coastal Path, with strong bird life and watersports.
quote: The 22 mile Sefton Coastal path starts here and a section of the national cycle path network runs the length of the Park ... large marine lake popular for water sports, formal gardens, amenity grasslands and a children's playground

claim: Ainsdale & Birkdale Sandhills (988 ha) is one of Britain's largest wild dune areas, famous for natterjack toads ('Birkdale Nightingale'), sand lizards and great crested newts; parking at Ainsdale Discovery Centre.
quote: one of the largest areas of wild dune land left in Britain ... ideal breeding pools for Natterjack Toads, whose astonishing chorus earns it the local name of 'Birkdale Nightingale' ... A car park is available at Ainsdale Discovery Centre

claim: Ainsdale Sand Dunes NNR has ~8 miles of way-marked footpaths; the Woodland Path and Fisherman's Path are wheelchair/pushchair/cycle accessible; reachable on foot from Ainsdale or Freshfield rail stations.
quote: The reserve has a network of around 8 miles of footpaths marked with colour-topped posts. The Woodland Path and Fisherman's Path are accessible by bike, pushchairs and wheelchairs

claim: Mere Sands Wood (Rufford) is a 42-ha Lancashire Wildlife Trust reserve with six accessible hides, 170+ recorded bird species, red squirrels and ~95% wheelchair-accessible paths; visitor centre/cafe open Wed-Sun 10:00-16:00; £4 car park.
quote: Visitor centre and cafe: Wednesday - Sunday, 10am - 4pm ... 42 hectares in size ... 95% of paths wheelchair/pram accessible ... six accessible hides

claim: WWT Martin Mere (Burscough, ~10 km from Aughton) opens 09:30-18:00 in summer (last entry 17:00) with free on-site parking; activities include canoe safaris, pond dipping and adventure play.
quote: The centre is open 9.30am to 6pm (last entry 5pm) ... The gift shop is open 9:30am until 5:30pm

claim: Beacon Country Park (Up Holland) covers 300+ acres of meadow, woodland and ponds with free parking, café, orienteering course and a Tramper off-road mobility scooter for hire.
quote: over 300 acres of rolling countryside ... flowing wildflower meadows, grassland, natural ponds and areas of semi-natural woodland ... off-road mobility scooter (Tramper) available for hire

claim: Croxteth Country Park has a free car park (locked overnight) and includes Croxteth Home Farm with rare breeds, a miniature railway, parkrun routes and Grade II* Croxteth Hall.
quote: Free car park off Muirhead Avenue East/Oak Lane ... Croxteth Hall, a Grade II* listed stately home, is the historic seat of the Molyneux family ... Croxteth Home Farm (rare breed animals, historic farming) ... Miniature railway

claim: Rivington Terraced Gardens / Lever Park (borderline ~30 km east) offer four free car parks (Lower House nearest to the gardens, ~80 cars), with on-site cafés including Great House Barn and The Café at Spring Cottage.
quote: Lower House Car park ... can hold up to 80 cars and is the nearest one to the Terraced Gardens ... Parking is free but visitors are requested to pay a small donation

claim: Mere Sands Wood car park is open 24 hours with a £4 charge; payment by cash (coins), card, contactless or RingGo code 25807.
quote: The car park is open 24 hours a day, with a £4 charge ... the RingGo app code for Mere Sands Wood is 25807

claim: Rufford Old Hall (NT) opens house 11:00–16:30 and garden/tea-room 10:30–16:30 on a typical late-May Saturday; adult admission £13.00.
quote: House: 11:00 AM - 4:30 PM; Garden: 10:30 AM - 4:30 PM; Tea-room: 10:30 AM - 4:30 PM. Adult (18+): £13.00 without Gift Aid

claim: Speke Hall's Tudor mansion is closed on Saturdays in 2026; only the gardens (10:00–17:00) and restaurant (10:00–16:30) are open Saturday, so it is a grounds-only pick on a Moor-Hall dinner day.
quote: Saturday Opening Hours: Gardens 10:00 - 17:00, while Hall is Closed. The restaurant serves from 10:00 - 16:30.

claim: Meols Hall (Churchtown, Southport) opens to the public only on May Bank Holiday Mondays and late-August through 25 September daily 13:30–17:30 — so it is NOT visitable on a typical Saturday.
quote: open to the public on May Bank Holiday Mondays: 4th & 25th and August Bank Holiday Monday 31st August until Friday 25th September daily, 1.30pm until 5.30pm

claim: Croxteth Hall and Walled Garden open daily 10:30–17:00 from 24 March to 30 September; the surrounding country park stays open 07:00–19:00 in summer — easy mid-afternoon stop before driving back to Aughton.
quote: Hall & Walled Garden: 24th March - 30th September: Monday to Sunday 10:30 - 17:00. Country Park: 1st April - 31st October: Monday to Sunday 07:00 - 19:00

claim: Astley Hall in Chorley reopens 5 April 2026 with free entry while West Wing restoration continues; only east-wing ground-floor rooms accessible until late July 2026, after which opening expands Tuesday–Sunday.
quote: Astley Hall Museum will be open for free visits from Sunday 5 April 2026 until late July 2026, alongside the ongoing West Wing restoration works

claim: Hoghton Tower offers self-guided Saturday house and garden access 11:00–16:00 (last entry 15:30) from 4 April to 3 October 2026 — workable but borderline 30 km and several Saturdays are closed for events.
quote: Self-Guided House Visits are available on Saturdays from April 4th to October 3rd, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM (last entry at 3:30 PM)

claim: Sefton Park Palm House (Liverpool) is a free Victorian glasshouse open daily 10:30–18:30 in summer — a long-window, low-commitment heritage stop that easily fits before a 19:00 Moor Hall slot.
quote: The Palm House is open from April 1st to October 31st from 10:30 am to 6:30 pm ... Admission to the Palm House and Sefton Park is free.

claim: Scarisbrick Hall (Pugin Gothic Revival, A570 between Ormskirk and Southport) is a school today and only opens for two booked public days in 2026 — 20 August and 23 October — so it is not a generic Saturday option.
quote: Open days are scheduled to be held on 20 August and 23 October, with booking required.

claim: Burscough Priory is an Augustinian ruin founded c.1190, dissolved 1536; only two crossing piers and chancel-wall stumps remain, freely accessible as a Scheduled Ancient Monument — a 15-minute drive-by stop, not a half-day.
quote: The remains consist of the two piers at the junction of the north transept and the crossing ... It is a Scheduled Ancient Monument ... Entry is often free for general exploration of the ruins.

claim: Lytham Hall (Georgian, Fylde coast) opens parkland daily 10:00–16:30 and the Georgian Hall 12:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); pay on the door — sits at the outer edge of the 30 km radius.
quote: Parkland is open daily from 10:00am to 4:30pm ... Georgian Hall is open daily from 12:00pm to 4:00pm (last entry 3:00pm) ... Pre booking is not required - just pay on the door.

claim: Walker Art Gallery in Liverpool city centre opens Saturday 10:00–17:00 with free admission — a strong wet-weather plan B inside the 30 km radius.
quote: open on Saturdays from 10 am–5 pm. Admission is free to the Gallery and to all exhibitions and events.

claim: Royal Albert Dock is a free open-air heritage waterfront in Liverpool, the most-visited free attraction in North West England, with bars, restaurants and museums clustered around the historic basin.
quote: Royal Albert Dock Liverpool is the most-visited free tourist destination in North West England

claim: Tate Liverpool's Albert Dock building is closed for redevelopment; the gallery is operating from a temporary home at RIBA North, Mann Island, free entry, open 10:00-17:50.
quote: Tate Liverpool is currently open at RIBA North, Mann Island (10.00-17.50), while their Royal Albert Dock home is temporarily closed for redevelopment.

claim: National Museums Liverpool venues (Museum of Liverpool, Walker Art Gallery, World Museum) are open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 with free admission.
quote: Our museums and galleries are open from 10am-5pm, Tuesday to Sunday

claim: Both the International Slavery Museum and Merseyside Maritime Museum closed in January 2025 for redevelopment and are due to reopen in 2028 — not available for a 2026 visit.
quote: Both museums are due to reopen in 2028

claim: The Beatles Story at Royal Albert Dock opens Saturday 09:00-18:30 (last entry 17:15), Sun-Fri 09:00-17:30.
quote: Sunday – Friday: 9am – 5:30pm (last entry 4:15pm) and Saturday: 9am – 6:30pm (last entry 5:15pm)

claim: Beatles Story admission is £20 adult, £16 concession, £11 child (5-15), under-5s free; ticket includes multilingual audio guide.
quote: Adults: £20.00 (ages 16+); Concessions: £16.00; Children: £11.00 (ages 5-15)

claim: The Cavern Club on Mathew Street is open 11:00-02:00 Friday & Saturday with single entry £6 or all-day pass £8.50, cashless only.
quote: Adults (18+) single entry: £6 (Pay on the door); All Day & Night pass: £8.50

claim: Liverpool Cathedral (Anglican) is open Saturday 10:00-18:00 with the Tower Experience available 10:00-16:30 last entry; building entry is free.
quote: Saturdays the Cathedral is open 10:00am-18:00pm with the Tower available 10:00am-16:30pm

claim: The Metropolitan Cathedral of Christ the King is open daily 07:30-18:00 with free admission; Lutyens Crypt is open Mon-Sat 10:00-16:00 (last entry 15:30).
quote: Open Monday to Sunday 7.30am to 6.00pm. Crypt open Monday to Saturday from 10am to 4pm (last visit at 3.30pm)

claim: The British Music Experience in the Cunard Building (Pier Head) is open Wed-Sun 10:00-17:00 (last entry 15:45); admission £21 walk-up / £19 pre-booked online for adults.
quote: Wednesday to Sunday from 10am to 5pm, with last admission at 3:45pm. General admission is £21 (£19 if pre-booked online)

claim: Liverpool ONE shopping district opens 09:00-19:00 on Saturdays; the on-site car parks total around 3,000 spaces with tariffs from ~£3.30/hour and £22/24hr, with a 15% discount via the LIVONE promo code.
quote: Saturday: 9 am to 7 pm... around 3,000 car parking spaces. Parking starts at around £3.30 for 1 hour, £11 for 5 hours, and £22 for 24 hours

claim: Mersey Ferries' 50-minute River Explorer Cruise from Pier Head runs hourly on Saturdays with the last boat departing Seacombe at 16:00 (Liverpool side ~20 past the hour).
quote: On Saturdays and Sundays, the last boat departs at 16:00, hourly from Seacombe with departures at 20 minutes past the hour

claim: Driving from Aughton to central Liverpool covers about 10 miles and takes roughly 19 minutes in typical traffic via the A59/M58.
quote: The driving distance between Aughton to Liverpool is 10 miles... approximately 19 min to drive

claim: Town Green station is on the Merseyrail Northern Line with direct services to Liverpool Central via Ormskirk branch trains.
quote: Town-green train station | timetable | ticket prices & facilities | Merseyrail

claim: Trains from Aughton Park / Town Green to Liverpool Central run roughly every 15 minutes on the Merseyrail Ormskirk-Liverpool branch with a journey time around 30-35 minutes; advance fares from ~£8.79.
quote: Trains Aughton Park to Liverpool from $10.79

claim: Southport Pier has been closed since December 2022 and repair works are expected to begin in early 2026, taking approximately 14 months — so it will be closed throughout a May 2026 visit.
quote: the iconic Southport Pier...has sadly been closed since December 2022 for health and safety reasons. Repair and refurbishment works to Southport Pier are expected to get underway in early 2026. Once they start the works will take approximately fourteen months to complete

claim: A £20m UK Government Growth Mission Fund award unlocked the full restoration of the Grade II-listed Southport Pier in 2026.
quote: A full restoration of the unsafe structure, which has been closed since December 2022 for health and safety reasons, will now take place thanks to a £20 million investment from the UK Government's Growth Mission Fund.

claim: Southport's Victorian Botanic Gardens north of the centre have an 1874 glasshouse, lake and flowerbeds; nearby Hesketh Park (Edward Kemp, 1860s) sits at the north end of Lord Street with themed gardens, fountains and a lake.
quote: The Victorian Botanic Gardens is a calm pocket just north of the town centre with paths around the lake, colourful flowerbeds and an ornate glasshouse dating back to 1874

claim: Hesketh Park is a Victorian public park designed by Edward Kemp in the mid-19th century, situated near the north end of Lord Street.
quote: Hesketh Park is a public park situated near the north end of Lord Street in the Victorian seaside town of Southport... designed as a public park in the mid-19th century by Edward Kemp.

claim: Southport is hosting its first-ever Year of Culture in 2026 with major headline events including Lightport (Feb), the Big Top Festival (May) and Books Alive! (Oct), making 2026 an unusually rich year to visit.
quote: 2026 marks a standout year for Southport as it hosts its first-ever Year of Culture... Lightport – An immersive light and sound installation (14-16 February), Big Top Festival featuring world-leading circus performers (2-3 May), and Books Alive!

claim: Southport Pleasureland has been rebranded as Adventure Coast Southport, with free park entry and weekend/school-holiday operation 11am–5pm; rides are paid via a £36 unlimited wristband or a £2 top-up Fun Card.
quote: The park is open every weekend and daily during school holidays from 11am – 5pm... Entry to the park is now completely free... Unlimited Access Wristbands are priced at £36... or a Fun Card is available for just £2 per person

claim: Southport's 140-acre Marine Lake offers boating, pedalos, motor boats and landscaped promenade walks, originally built in the 19th century as a low-tide haven for vessels.
quote: Southport Marine Lake is a 140 acre purpose built lake which was originally constructed in the 19th century... With its shimmering waters, beautiful landscaped promenades and lush gardens, the Marine Lake is perfect for leisurely walks, picnics, and boating activities.

claim: The Atkinson in Southport is currently free to enter and runs the '20 Years of Another Place' photography exhibition (Ron Davies' shots of the Gormley figures) — a thematic tie-in for visitors combining Southport culture with a Crosby Beach trip.
quote: stunning photographs of Crosby beach's Iron Men, taken over two decades by Crosby photographer Ron Davies, are on display at The Atkinson in Southport

claim: Crosby Beach's 'Another Place' consists of 100 cast-iron, life-size Gormley body-casts spread across 3 km of foreshore and almost 1 km out to sea — each 189 cm tall and ~650 kg.
quote: Another Place consists of 100 cast-iron, life-size figures spread out along three kilometres of the foreshore, stretching almost one kilometre out to sea. The figures are cast replicas of Gormley's own body. Each figure is 189 centimeters tall and weighs about 650 kilograms.

claim: Crosby is a non-bathing beach with soft sand, mud and tide risk; visitors must stay within 50 m of the promenade and time visits to low tide.
quote: Crosby beach is a non-bathing beach with areas of soft sand and mud and a risk of changing tides. Visitors should stay within 50 metres of the promenade at all times and not attempt to walk out to the furthest figures.

claim: Formby sits within the North Merseyside/West Lancashire red squirrel stronghold — one of only a few UK refuges — with pine woods backing onto the dunes and beach.
quote: Formby is located within the North Merseyside and West Lancashire red squirrel stronghold, one of a few refuges left for red squirrels across the UK

claim: Formby's Victoria Road car park and toilets are closed until spring 2026 for a major conservation project, so visitors must use the Lifeboat Road entrance (free Blue Badge spaces) or arrive by train.
quote: Formby beach car park and toilets at Victoria Road are closed until spring 2026 for a major conservation project... the Lifeboat Road car park is the main option for parking.

claim: Formby Beach is dog-friendly year-round with no seasonal ban, but dogs must be leashed near the dunes to protect natterjacks and ground-nesting birds.
quote: Dogs are welcome year-round with no seasonal restrictions on the beach itself. However, dogs must be kept on a lead, especially near the dunes where wildlife protection is crucial.

claim: Ainsdale Sand Dunes NNR is one of the best remaining UK strongholds of the rare natterjack toad, with the Sefton Coast holding ~40% of the UK population.
quote: Ainsdale Sand Dunes National Nature Reserve is one of the best remaining strongholds of the rare natterjack toad, Europe's loudest amphibian. The Sefton Coast is home to 40% of the UK's population of rare natterjack toads.

claim: Aughton to Southport is roughly 11 miles / ~17 minutes by car — comfortably within a 30 km radius of Moor Hall.
quote: The driving distance between Aughton to Southport is 11 miles. It takes approximately 17 minutes to drive from Aughton to Southport.

claim: Lytham St Annes is ~30 miles / 29.7 mi by road from Ormskirk (Aughton sits next door), pushing it well over a 30 km radius — borderline-out for this trip.
quote: The distance between Lytham St Annes and Ormskirk is 30 miles, with a road distance of 29.7 miles.

claim: The £73m+ Marine Lake Events Centre (1,200-seat theatre, 2,400-capacity conference space) is under construction with main works expected to start later in 2026, meaning visitors will see hoardings around part of the lakefront.
quote: the Marine Lake Events Centre will boast a 1,200-seat theatre, 2,400-capacity conference centre, and various offices, food and beverage offering, meeting rooms, and production facilities. Main construction works are expected to begin on site later in 2026

claim: Knowsley Safari adult advance ticket £24.75 (£27.50 same-day), child 3-15 £22.50, toddler 1-2 £2.50, under-1 free.
quote: Adult (16+) Advanced Booking £24.75 Same Day £27.50 ... Child (3-15) £22.50/£25.00 ... Toddler (1-2) £2.50 ... Baby (Under 1) FREE

claim: Knowsley Safari is open 10am-5pm daily with last Safari Drive entry at 4pm.
quote: Park hours: 10am - 5pm. Safari Drive last entry: 4pm. The last Safari admission and last entry to the Safari Drive is 4pm.

claim: Knowsley Safari Park is about 13 miles / ~25 minutes by car from Aughton L39.
quote: The driving distance between Aughton to Knowsley Safari Park is 13 miles. It takes approximately 25 minutes to drive from Aughton to Knowsley Safari Park.

claim: WWT Martin Mere online advance adult £17.10, junior 3-17 £11.12, family (2+2) £48.11, under-3s free; on-the-day £19/£12.35/£53.45.
quote: Adult: £17.10 Junior (3-17 years): £11.12 Family (2 adults + 2 children): £48.11 ... Under 3 years: Free ... On-the-Day Adult: £19.00 Junior: £12.35 Family: £53.45

claim: Windmill Animal Farm in Burscough is open every day 10am-5pm and requires booking in advance.
quote: We are open everyday 10am - 5pm ... Please book your visit

claim: Windmill Animal Farm prices: adults £14.95, children 1-15 £15.95, under-1s free.
quote: Kids (1-15): £15.95, Adults: £14.95, and Under 1s are Free

claim: Farmer Ted's Adventure Farm (near Formby/Ormskirk) opens 10:00 daily during the 2026 season with weekends typically 10:00-17:15.
quote: Saturdays: 10:00 - 17:15 Sundays: 10:00 - 17:15 ... Weekdays (Mon-Fri): 10:00 - 17:00

claim: Farmer Ted's 2026 season runs 12 February to 6 September 2026 with all-inclusive entry covering indoor/outdoor play, animal demonstrations, and toboggan run.
quote: Our 2026 season runs from the 12th February - 6th September 2026 ... General admission tickets for Farmer Ted's 2026

claim: Farmer Ted's family of 4 paid roughly £33 off-peak; site is geared to toddlers and children up to about 10 with jumping pillows, toboggan run and tractor rides included.
quote: one reviewer mentioned paying £33 for 2 adults, 1 baby, and 1 three-year-old during off-peak school holidays ... Free Tractor Rides ... Jumping Pillows, Agility Trail, Toboggan Run

claim: Adventure Coast Southport (formerly Pleasureland) has free park entry; unlimited-ride wristbands released daily 11am-12pm at £36.
quote: Each day between 11am-12pm, we release a limited number of Unlimited Access Wristbands, priced at £36.

claim: Adventure Coast Southport opens every weekend 11am-5pm plus daily during school holidays, with pay-per-ride pricing from £1.
quote: Open every weekend, 11am-5pm and daily during school holidays ... Free entry daily ... Pay-per-ride pricing starts from £1

claim: Mattel Play! Liverpool permanently closed in June 2020 and is no longer operating.
quote: Mattel Play! Liverpool permanently closed on 4 June 2020, when Mattel ended their lease contract with Albert Dock

claim: Indoor-play options immediately around Aughton/Ormskirk are limited; nearest dedicated centres (Jungle Fun Belle Vale, Flip Out, Otterspool Adventure) sit ~30 minutes south in Liverpool.
quote: Within walking distance of Ormskirk, the options for dedicated indoor play are fairly limited ... Liverpool is around half an hour south along the A59 ... Jungle Fun ... Flip Out Liverpool ... Otterspool Adventure

claim: Ormskirk open-air street market runs each Thursday and Saturday 8am-4.30pm on pedestrianised Moor, Aughton and Church Streets, with up to 100 stalls selling fish, meat, fruit, veg, cheese, bread and pies.
quote: The market is open for business each Thursday and Saturday from 8.00am-4.30pm... Fresh cakes, fish, meat, fruit, vegetables, cheeses, bread, and pies

claim: The separate Ormskirk Food & Drink Market is an indoor hall on Moor Street with six street-food traders and a cocktail bar, open Thursday-Sunday with food Sat 10am-9pm.
quote: six traders serving up a variety of tasty street food... Thurs: 12pm - 9pm... Sat: 10am - 9pm

claim: Burscough Wharf, on the Leeds-Liverpool Canal a short drive north of Aughton, hosts independent eateries including Baja Mexican, Cactus Ray's Cafe & Deli, Gurkha Village Bar and Grill, Hugo's Cafe Bar, Milkie Bar, Only Scrans and The Thirsty Duck.
quote: Baja Mexican... Cactus Ray's Cafe & Deli... Gurkha Village Bar and Grill... Hugo's Cafe Bar... Milkie Bar... Only Scrans Burscough... The Thirsty Duck

claim: Liverpool Gin Distillery on Castle Street offers gin tastings at 4pm and 6.30pm and is open Tue-Thu 12pm-12am and Fri-Sun 12pm-1am; a Gin Tasting Experience runs 1 hour at £38.50pp.
quote: Monday - Closed; Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday - 12pm to 12am; Friday, Saturday, Sunday - 12pm to 1am

claim: The distillery spans four floors with a Gin Bar offering 40+ gins and a 600L copper pot still named Margaret producing Liverpool Gin on site.
quote: the ground floor features the Gin Bar home to over 40 different gins, as well as a 600L copper pot still named Margaret

claim: Black Lodge Brewing in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle runs a taproom on King's Dock Street pouring keg and cask, with resident food trader Fatback Burgers, open four days a week.
quote: The taproom serves their latest beers on keg and cask plus food from resident traders... Fatback Burgers, serves burgers when the taproom is open four days a week

claim: Southport Market on Market Street houses nine independent food traders (Tikka Bros, 600 Degrees pizza, Brunch N' Bagel, Pitamu Greek, Cake Corner, Pasta 51, Little Korean Kitchen, Lennys Smashport, Blackhurst Butchers) plus The Market Bar, open Wed-Thu 10am-10pm, Fri-Sat 10am-11pm, Sun 10am-8.30pm.
quote: Wednesday and Thursday 10am to 10pm. Friday and Saturday 10am to 11pm. Sunday 10am to 8:30pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday

claim: Birkdale Cheese Co at 42A Liverpool Road, Birkdale, Southport stocks over 150 cheeses and has traded in the village for 40+ years; open Mon-Sat 9-5, closed Sunday.
quote: Home to Over 150 Cheeses... 42A Liverpool Road, Birkdale, Southport PR8 4AY... Monday-Saturday: 9:00 - 17:00

claim: Owd Barn at Bispham, just outside Ormskirk, is a 16th-century listed barn farm shop with tea room serving farmhouse meals, cakes and fresh fruit pies plus locally-produced meat, fruit and veg.
quote: a rustic farm shop, a unique gift loft, a country store, and a charming tea room... traditional farmhouse homemade meals, cakes and ice creams

claim: Bold Street in Liverpool is the city's independent dining strip with global cuisines, anchored by Mowgli (Nisha Katona's Indian tiffin spot), Bundobust Indian-vegetarian-and-craft-beer, Maray's Middle Eastern small plates and LEAF teashop.
quote: Bold Street is the beating heart of Liverpool's independent dining scene... Mowgli, created by Nisha Katona MBE... Bundobust combines Indian vegetarian street food with craft beer... Maray serves Middle Eastern small plates

claim: Salt Dog Slim's at 79 Seel Street, Liverpool serves American-style chilli dogs in brioche, world beers and steins, open until 2-3am most nights.
quote: Salt Dog Slims is an emporium of world beers, bespoke cocktails, and American style chilli dogs... 79 Seel Street L1 4BB

claim: Lagom Bakery on Merlin Park, Ormskirk does sourdough, pastry and specialty coffee; open Wed-Sat 9-3 and Sun 9-1.
quote: Lagom Bakery specializes in sourdough, pastry, and coffee with locations in Ormskirk (open 9-3 Wed-Sat, 9-1 Sun)

claim: Bloom & Brew in Ormskirk is a takeout specialty coffee shop pouring beans from Liverpool roaster Neighbourhood Coffee plus rotating guest roasters, two minutes from Ormskirk station.
quote: takeout specialty locally roasted coffee, drinks and cakes from rotating roasters and bakers, and always has Liverpool house roasters, Neighbourhood Coffee, beans and filter packs available

claim: The Kicking Donkey near Ormskirk is a contemporary British gastropub praised for fish and chips with a crisp non-oily batter, open fire and reasonable prices.
quote: The Kicking Donkey in Ormskirk offers an exceptional experience in Contemporary British cuisine, with freshly cooked dishes made with local produce. The fish and chips are particularly noteworthy

claim: Crosby and Waterloo's St John's Road is lined with independent retailers and restaurants, with Cafe V76, The Little Deli (Buddha bowls with Crosby Coffee), Crosby Coffee Roasters and StoryHouse community café standing out for a foodie detour after Antony Gormley's Another Place on the beach.
quote: St John's Road is the west Merseyside version of Lark Lane with a whole street of independent retailers and restaurants lining up locally-sourced delicious food
